title: About the ECUSTA Student Council
statement: The official representative body of students at the Ethiopian Catholic University of St. Thomas Aquinas (ECUSTA). We advocate for student interests, advance academic excellence, promote student welfare, and foster a vibrant, inclusive, and supportive campus community.

pillars.title: Student Advocacy & Voice
pillars.description: Serving as the direct bridge between the student body and university leadership to represent student perspectives, address concerns, and support student rights.

pillars.title: Academic Excellence
pillars.description: Encouraging collaborative study initiatives, peer mentorship, academic resources, and educational workshops for all students.

pillars.title: Student Welfare & Campus Life
pillars.description: Fostering an inclusive campus environment, supporting student wellness, and encouraging meaningful student engagement across the university.
